tiles: Geometric structure meets flowing landscape forms
Vibrant gradients across mountains and calm water
Generative compositions with disciplined color pacing
challenge: Applying constructivist geometric frameworks to natural landscape subjects, finding the balance between structural rigor and the organic flow of mountains, water, and sky. The series needed to feel both architecturally precise and naturally evocative across varied terrain compositions.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to establish compositional axes and gradient fields across mountain and water scenes. Lightroom handled color pacing and warm-to-cool transitions, while in-painting refined edge control, value steps, and spatial rhythm within each landscape panel.
result: Produced a six-piece landscape series that merges constructivist discipline with natural terrain beauty. The cohesive panels read clearly at tile scale and hold layered depth for large-format art prints and digital portfolio display.
